title: Implement Prometheus metrics for transit daemon
description:
Define and register Prometheus metrics for the transit daemon: articles_ingested_total (counter), ipfs_write_latency_seconds (histogram), gc_articles_unpinned_total (counter), gossip_messages_published_total (counter), gossip_messages_dropped_total (counter), peer_connections_active (gauge). Expose /metrics HTTP endpoint. Artifact: transit/src/metrics.rs.

Acceptance:
- /metrics endpoint returns valid Prometheus text format
- All metrics above are present in the output after basic operations
- Metric names follow prometheus naming conventions (snake_case, _total suffix for counters)
- Unit test: verify metric names and label sets
